reasoning_content:
The issue: system `libgeotiff.so.5` and `libspatialite.so.7` (old Ubuntu versions) link against libproj.so.22. GDAL 3.8.4 from PPA links libproj.so.25, but it also loads plugins/other libs that pull in libproj22. Two different PROJ versions loaded in the same process cause the crash at exit.

Actually the segfault happens at "exit" in proj destructor. It's a known conflict mixing libproj versions. We need matching libgeotiff and libspatialite from PPA. The PPA provides updated versions. Right now we have old libgeotiff.so.5 (from Ubuntu) still. Let's update libgeotiff and libspatialite from PPA.

Actually GDAL PPA should have pulled updated deps. Let's check which packages from PPA are available for libgeotiff5, libspatialite7.

Actually the loop output showed system libgeotiff.so links libproj.so.22 — that's the old one. The ubuntugis PPA version of libgeotiff would link libproj.so.25. Let's install from PPA with candidate. Check policy.

action.command: apt-cache policy libgeotiff5 libspatialite7 libgeotiff-dev libspatialite-dev 2>/dev/null | grep -E "libgeotiff5|libspatialite7|libgeotiff-dev|libspatialite-dev|Installed|Candidate"
